profile.headline: Junior Software Developer at Self-Employed
profile.summary:
Software engineer/ web developer, seeking an entry level Software Developer position. In my previous career, I also have many years of problem solving / crisis management. In addition, I have a background of C programming in Telecom.

I have also recently completed an intensive, immersive 12-week web development program at RockIT Bootcamp. This is a full stack development school using: HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, jQuery, JSON, Ajax, PHP and mySQL, in individual and team projects. We also used Agile and Scrum development methodology, as well as utilized Github.

In the Bootcamp, I exclusively wrote the backend PHP and mySQL code for the team projects. All projects were proactively completed ahead of the project deadlines.

After the RockIT bootcamp ended, I began a college course in Java for its similarity to C#, which I am currently enrolled, to help prepare me for an active role in the enterprise. My current grade is 100% at the 99% completion point.

My key strengths are:
•	Java (C#)
•	MySQL, JavaScript, jQuery, HTML5, CSS 3, JSON, Ajax, PHP
•	Strong communication skills
•	Team player, and able to work independently as well
•	Excellent problem solving skills

projects.title: Robotics Project - "Internet of Things" Embedded Systems
projects.description:
Built the physical hardware, and designed the software for a robot, using a Raspberry Pi computer that I put a LAMP stack environment on. The robot is able to be controlled via a wireless connection to the Pi APACHE web server. In my project I developed an HTML5, CSS 3, JavaScript, and jQuery user interface to control the robot's movements. The robot is able to perform free-form commands chosen by the user, or perform complex command sequences stored in the database.
This interface was also designed to work as a mobile app.
The robot communicates to the MySQL database via AJAX and PHP. PHP also sends the Python command sequences to the robot's GPIO pins.
The robot will also have the ability for the user to add specific command sequences "on-the-fly" to the robot, that will be stored in the database in order to be used again; proximity sensing, a webcam, GPS, and a robotic arm.
The next project is to use Java for the backend language, replacing PHP.
